title: Director of Continuous Improvement
text:
**Role Description**
The Director of Continuous Improvement is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading enterprise-wide initiatives to optimize business processes and strengthen operational performance. This role designs and implements continuous improvement frameworks, establishes measurable performance indicators, and partners with leaders across functions to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing processes and data, facilitating workshops, coaching teams on best practices, and driving standardization of tools and methodologies. The Director will develop roadmaps, monitor progress against targets, and communicate outcomes to senior leadership while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and learning. This position also mentors team members and stakeholders to build internal capability in continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Business Process Improvement and Process Improvement methodologies, with the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Proven track record in Operational Excellence and Operations Management, including designing and sustaining efficient, scalable workflows.
* Strong Analytical Skills with proficiency in using data, metrics, and root cause analysis to diagnose issues and recommend solutions.
* Experience implementing continuous improvement frameworks (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) and using related tools and techniques.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, in a remote environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including facilitation of workshops, training sessions, and presentations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma Black Belt) are beneficial.
* Proven experience in a leadership role overseeing process improvement or operational excellence programs, ideally in complex or multi-site organizations.
